# Nova Rush voice callouts — Kokoro TTS (Kokoro-82M, voice af_heart, en-us).
# Generated by Tools/kokoro_voices.sh (the line table with both takes' texts
# and speeds lives there); raw takes land in generated/voices/ (git-ignored).
#
# Licensing: Kokoro-82M weights are Apache-2.0 and the model was trained only
# on permissive / non-copyrighted audio (model card, hexgrad/Kokoro-82M); the
# kokoro-tts CLI and kokoro-onnx conversion are MIT. Chosen to replace the
# earlier VoiceStudio/OmniVoice takes, whose weights are CC-BY-NC (training
# data Emilia is CC BY-NC 4.0) — not compatible with an open release.
#
# Voice audition: af_heart, af_bella, af_nova and bf_emma were compared;
# af_heart was chosen as the clearest and easiest to understand.
#
# Two takes per line (<name>.wav, <name>_2.wav; the game picks one at random).
# Take 2 uses a 70/30 blend af_heart + af_nicole (the most clearly different
# of the blends tried; speed changes alone were inaudible).
# Kokoro is deterministic: same text + speed = same take, so take 2 varies the
# wording or the speed. All 44 takes passed Tools/voicecheck.swift (no garbled
# takes — unlike OmniVoice, where ~1/3 of short takes failed).
#
# name        take 1                                   take 2
multiball     Multiball!                               Multiball. (0.95)
jackpot       Jackpot!                                 Jackpot! (0.92)
warp          Warp!                                    Warp jump!
ballsaved     Ball saved.                              Ball saved! (0.95)
tilt          Tilt.                                    Tilt! (0.92)
asteroid      Asteroid storm!                          same (0.93)
solarflare    Solar flare!                             same (0.93)
gravitywell   Gravity well!                            Gravity well. (0.95)
modelit       Mode is lit.                             same (0.93)
locklit       Lock is lit.                             same (0.93)
locked        Ball locked.                             Ball locked! (0.95)
nova          Nova!                                    same (0.92)
gameover      Game over.                               The game is over.
highscore     New high score!                          A new high score! (0.95)
welcome       Welcome to Nova Rush. Launch when ready. same, "!" (0.95)
extraball     Extra ball!                              You earned an extra ball!
shootagain    Shoot again!                             Same player, shoot again!
eblit         Extra ball is lit.                       The extra ball is lit.
skillshot     Skill shot!                              Skill shot. (0.95)
superskill    Super skill shot!                        same (0.93)
combo         Combo!                                   Combo shot!
supercombo    Super combo!                             Super combo. (0.95)

# Lost-ball quips — callout "balllost", spoken in Tuning.lostBallQuipChance
# (10 %) of really lost balls (not ball-saved, not one ball of a multiball),
# priority 1 so "Shoot again!" / "Game over." still get through. One take per
# quip (balllost.wav, balllost_2 … _11), alternating af_heart and the blend.
#   Bad luck! · Oh no! · Oh dear! · Damn! · Oh crap! · No no no! · Ouch! ·
#   So close! · Not again! · Lost in space. · Gravity wins.
# Test: --continuoustest --quip 1 (expect 7 quips) / --quip 0 (expect 0).

# Attract-show invitations — callout "attract", spoken while no game runs:
# first ≈60 s into the show, then about every 3 min (GameScene
# attractVoiceTiming), only while the app is in front, priority 1. One take
# per line (attract.wav, attract_2 … _6), alternating af_heart and the blend.
#   Ready for launch, pilot? · Hey, pilot! Press space to play. ·
#   All systems go. We just need a pilot. · Come on. The stars won't wait
#   forever. · Nova Rush. No coins needed. Just courage. · Feel the rush!
#   Come and play.
# Test: --attract --attracttest (invitation after 1.5 s).
